categories.name: Release A
categories.description: Represents the standard discharge pathway for admitted sepsis patients, contributing to the avoidance of post-discharge deterioration and measured against post-discharge ER return indicators.
categories.rationale: Default 1:1 mapping to declared alternative Release A (id=17), observed frequently in the narrative sample (e.g. V0008, V0070) concluding successful inpatient treatment without subdivision.

categories.name: Release B
categories.description: Represents an alternative discharge pathway for admitted sepsis patients, contributing to avoiding post-discharge deterioration and monitored via post-discharge ER return rates.
categories.rationale: Default 1:1 mapping to declared alternative Release B (id=18), observed in specific variants such as V0068 and V0145.

categories.name: Release C
categories.description: Represents an alternative discharge route for complex or extended inpatient stays, tracked against post-discharge ER return outcomes.
categories.rationale: Default 1:1 mapping to declared alternative Release C (id=19), evidenced by long-running complex traces like V0710.

categories.name: Release D
categories.description: Represents a specialized or alternate discharge pathway for patients after prolonged clinical management, measured by post-discharge ER return metrics.
categories.rationale: Default 1:1 mapping to declared alternative Release D (id=20), found in extended variants such as V0273.

categories.name: Release E
categories.description: Represents a distinct terminal discharge category for admitted cases reaching final disposition.
categories.rationale: Default 1:1 mapping to declared alternative Release E (id=21) as specified in the goal model's XOR decomposition for discharged cases.
